trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
steps: Work the roadmap stage by stage: the story first, then the missables, the sweep, the grind and the cleanup run.
Every trophy below feeds this one; the counter on the pause menu shows how many of the 54 you still need.
The platinum pops automatically the moment the last trophy lands, then sync your console trophies.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
steps: Start a new game and play the dockside opening out of the Port Gellhorn marina without skipping the tutorial prompts.
Follow the partner through the bait-shop shootout, then drive the getaway boat out past the harbour buoys.
The trophy pops in the cutscene when the state map opens for the first time.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
steps: Chapter 1 runs from Breakfast Run to The Cartel Heist; clear every mission in between in order.
Take the heist payout however loud it gets, since the chapter only closes when the take is banked.
The trophy pops on the chapter-end screen back at the safehouse.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
steps: Chapter 2 opens with Child's Play and closes with Headliners; play both plus the setup missions between them.
Keep the crew alive during the Headliners escape, because a downed driver fails the mission outright.
The trophy pops on the chapter-end screen after the arena escape.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
steps: Chapter 3 moves into the city: VCIA Takedown and Operation Savage Glory bookend it.
Drive between the chapter's objectives instead of flying, since several roadside calls count toward later strands.
The trophy pops on the chapter-end screen after the rig goes down.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
steps: Chapter 4 is a short chain of setups feeding straight into the final mission.
Keep a hard save at the chapter start so the ending choice can be revisited for the cleanup trophies.
The trophy pops when the final mission completes on this first run.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
steps: The final mission unlocks after Chapter 4's last setup; go in with full body armor and your highest-capacity rifle.
Any ending counts, since the trophy is for finishing the job rather than for which choice you make.
Skip the credits to bank it faster, then keep the save for the 100% grind.

trophies.name: Trust
steps: Breakfast Run appears after the prologue on the west highway; take any car to the diner marker.
Tail the convoy at a distance, then swap vehicles at the fuel stop so the spotters lose you.
The trophy pops when the briefcase hand-off scene ends.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
steps: The Cartel Heist unlocks late in Chapter 1; pick the roof entry and the quiet drill to keep the alarm window short.
Carry the duffel yourself, since the partner drops it under fire.
The trophy pops at the mission-end screen once the payout boat is reached.

trophies.name: Family Matters
steps: Child's Play opens Chapter 2 in the Grassrivers trailer district; bring a silenced pistol for the yard section.
Keep the hostage alive through the exchange, because a stray shot fails the whole mission.
The trophy pops after the drive back to the safehouse.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
steps: Headliners is the Chapter 2 closer at the arena district; enter through the loading dock, not the front gate.
Plant the second charge during the fireworks so the blast is covered by the show.
Escape in the partner's car; the trophy pops as the chapter ends.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
steps: VCIA Takedown opens in Chapter 3 after the airport recon; grab the tug vehicle from the cargo ramp.
Breach the private jet with the boarding stairs and hold the cockpit while the partner disarms the cargo.
Fly out low over the bay; the trophy pops when you land on the Keys airstrip.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
steps: The Chapter 3 closer runs from the naval yard to the offshore platform; stock up on body armor first.
Fight up the rig deck by deck and plant charges at all three marked valves.
The trophy pops on the chapter-end screen after the rig cutscene.

trophies.name: A Long Road
steps: The 100% checklist covers story, strands, challenges, collectibles and activities; the pause menu shows your live percentage.
Clear the roadmap stages in order, since the collectible sweep and the activity grind are the biggest chunks.
Hold a save at 90% and knock out each remaining category one at a time.
The trophy pops when the checklist hits 100%.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
steps: Stunts are the airborne and near-miss moments the game toasts on screen; every toast adds one to the counter.
Chain jumps along the Keys causeway, where the ramps repeat and each landing counts.
Ride the airport service roads on a sport bike at night, when the traffic is thin.
Track the running total on the stats page; the trophy pops at 250.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
steps: The nine activity types are races, Top Fun drone races, the shooting range, fishing, arcades, bowling, meditation, robberies and stunts.
Clear one of each type; most only need participation rather than a win.
The activities tab ticks each type as you go; the trophy pops on the last unseen one.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
steps: The shooting range sits under the Port Gellhorn boardwalk; golds are decided by time plus accuracy, not just a pass.
Bring your own scoped rifle, since the range guns are stock and slow.
Clear the 42 challenges in sets of ten so the later tiers build on muscle memory.
Retry instantly from the range menu; the trophy pops on the last gold.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
steps: Top Fun Drone Race markers are antenna icons at 14 sites across the map.
Fly one practice lap per site to learn the gate order before the real run.
Win once at each site, since a win ticks the site permanently.
The trophy pops when the 14th site is cleared.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
steps: Street races, boat races and off-road rallies each count as distinct events.
New race flags appear on the map after story chapters; check for them each time one closes.
Wins count in any vehicle class, and checkpoint rewinds do not void them.
The trophy pops on the 20th different win.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
steps: Cal is the old-timer at the Port Gellhorn pier; his challenge opens after the fishing tutorial.
He offers the challenge once: decline it or lose and walk away, and the marker is gone for the rest of the save.
Bring the mid-weight rod and reel in short taps; Cal folds around ten pounds.
Missed him? He never returns, so this one waits for the second-run cleanup.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
steps: Arcades are dotted along Vice Beach; any cabinet played to its end screen counts.
The racing cabinet is the fastest clear: hold the inside lane and never brake.
The trophy pops when the high-score screen appears.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
steps: Andy's strand starts at the northside rehab clinic and runs three missions.
His finale is the clinic rescue; bring a four-door so the whole group escapes together.
The trophy pops when his strand-complete call comes in.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
steps: Kenton's strand starts at the Leonida Keys marina after Chapter 2.
The finale is the reef salvage; winch the wreck in calm weather and fight off the rival crew.
The trophy pops when the salvage is delivered.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
steps: Billy's strand runs out of the Grassrivers ranch and unlocks after Chapter 1.
His finale is the long-haul cattle drive; herd with the dirt bike, not the truck.
The trophy pops when the herd reaches the Port Gellhorn yards.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
steps: Mission strands are the letter icons scattered across Leonida; each runs two to four missions.
Finish eight different strands to completion; Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and Bret all count toward the eight.
The trophy pops when the eighth strand's finale ends.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
steps: Randy's strand opens at the Redhill storage depot in Chapter 3.
His finale is the warehouse supply war; hold the stockroom until the timer runs down.
The trophy pops when the depot is secured.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
steps: Tyrone's strand starts at the Vice Beach radio tower and only appears at night.
His finale is the rooftop turntable battle; keep the speakers powered while the rival DJs rush the stage.
The trophy pops when the rooftop clears.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
steps: Eighteen meditation spots sit on hilltops, piers and roof gardens across Leonida; found ones get a map pin.
Sit through each breathing sequence until the screen glows, because walking away early does not count.
The pause menu lists every spot; the trophy pops on the 18th.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
steps: Bret is the trophy hunter camped in the Grassrivers swamp; his mark is the albino panther that spawns only during his hunt.
The animal exists only while Bret's hunt is active; skip it or fail it and it never spawns again.
Follow the scent trail, then take the shot from the treeline with the scoped rifle.
Skin the kill with Bret and the trophy pops on the spot.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
steps: Collectible Cards drop from shops, stunt jumps and gang stashes; each set has its own theme.
Complete any three sets, since the binder in the pause menu shows which cards are still missing.
Trade duplicate cards at the comic shop near Vice Beach to close a set fast.
The trophy pops when the third set completes.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
steps: WAiNK It is the phone map app; open it at 100 different named locations to tick them.
Drive each district's main roads with the app open, since each new neighbourhood pin counts once.
Sweep the Keys and the northern lakes by helicopter, where road pins are sparse.
The trophy pops on the 100th pin.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
steps: Challenges are the tiered lists under the pause menu: stunt, combat, driving and misc.
Complete any 50 across all lists, since the stunt and shooting-range grinds feed this automatically.
Knock out the easy driving tiers first, then mop up combat kills during missions.
The trophy pops on the 50th completion.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
steps: Start the chaos in a two-seat car with the partner riding shotgun.
Raise the heat to four stars near the downtown precinct, then break line of sight in the metro tunnel.
Stay in the same vehicle, because a downed or lost partner voids the escape.
The trophy pops when the stars clear.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
steps: Pick three convenience shops on one block of Vice Beach so the timer between hits stays generous.
Rob each till at gunpoint and keep moving; the wanted level must survive all three hits.
After the third till, shake the heat in the tunnel under the beach.
The trophy pops once the stars clear after shop three.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
steps: A vehicle is discovered once it is driven or scanned; stolen, bought and mission vehicles all count.
Sweep each district's traffic, then hit the marinas and airfields for boats and planes.
Buy out the cheap used lots to fill the rarest slots.
The trophy pops when the 100th vehicle is logged.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
steps: Combat Focus is the partner ability that slows time; fire it with a full meter.
Set up at the gang yard by the docks and tag five enemies with headshots inside one focus.
Bring a shotgun indoors so each shot floors one target.
The trophy pops the moment the fifth enemy drops.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
steps: VCIA is the Vice City International Airport; the departure is any takeoff the tower never cleared.
Ram the gate in a fast car, drive onto the runway and take the prop plane parked at the cargo end.
Roll out past the hangars and lift off; the trophy pops when the wheels leave the runway.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
steps: Rhinos are the tanks the National Guard rolls out at five-star heat from the depot north of Port Gellhorn.
Lure one to a checkpoint, then pull the driver out when it stops to turn.
Ride the Rhino out under fire; the trophy pops while you are in the driver's seat and the heat is still on.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
steps: Hit the jeweler on the Vice Beach promenade after dark, when the street is empty.
Scout the back door, disable the alarm box, then crack the cases with the quiet drill.
Leave through the kitchen and the alley without a single sighting; the trophy pops at the alley exit.
Any alert or gunshot voids the run, so keep a save at the scouting step.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
steps: Five banks across Leonida hold drillable vaults; each needs a thermal lance bought from the fence.
Hit one per session, since heat from one run carries into the next.
Clear the alarm panel first, drill during the countdown and leave by the pre-placed escape car.
The trophy pops after the fifth vault escape.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
steps: Armored trucks run scheduled routes on the Leonida Expressway around noon.
Disable one with a spike strip near an underpass, then blast the rear doors with the sawed-off.
Grab the cash bags and swap cars at the next exit; the trophy pops when the heat clears.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
steps: Leonida splits into 52 named areas; each one counts when its name banner appears.
Use the pause menu map: discovered areas fill with colour, unseen ones stay grey.
Fly the coastline and lake country last; a few swamp areas only open by boat.
The trophy pops when the 52nd area is discovered.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
steps: Nine gangs run illegal operations: chop shops, drug fronts, fight pits and card rooms across Leonida.
Each operation is a marked raid; clear the guards and smash the stock.
Work through the nine raid markers; the trophy pops when the last gang's operation falls.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
steps: The moment fires only on the first evening you walk the Ocean Beach pier after Chapter 3; later visits just sell you a drink.
Walk the pier between sunset and midnight with no wanted level and order at the tiki bar.
Take the rail seat and the scene plays itself; the trophy pops as the toast ends.
Missed it? The trigger never comes back, so it waits for the second-run cleanup.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
steps: The showroom is the glass-fronted supercar store on the Vice Beach strip.
Buy nothing: get in the display car, rev it and drive straight through the front glass.
Keep the car running to the docks; the trophy pops the moment the glass shatters.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
steps: Kolt & Associates is the law firm in the downtown tower; its basement hides a private bowling alley.
The alley is reachable only during the firm's Chapter 2 storyline; it locks behind you when the case closes.
After the meeting, follow the partner down to the lanes and bowl the frame the game offers.
Follow through on the release; the trophy pops as the pins scatter.

trophies.name: Personal Best
steps: This is the partnership milestone: the moment your duo's social feed crosses its peak during the Chapter 3 finale build-up.
Post every feed clip the game prompts during missions, since skipping them means the moment never fires.
When the feed spikes during the Operation Savage Glory prep, check the phone to trigger the scene.
Missed it? Replay needed, so it lands on the second-run cleanup list.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
steps: The game tracks every story choice: dialogue forks, heist plans and ending branches all count.
Make a deliberate pick every time the prompt appears, since a skipped choice point is forfeited.
The counter spans the whole story plus strands, so skipping strands can leave you short at the finale.
Watch the stats page; if the count is short before the final mission, reload a chapter and vary your picks.
If the finale closes your save below the mark, the trophy falls to the second-run cleanup.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
steps: Fail any challenge or mission checkpoint on purpose, then beat it on the immediate retry.
The easiest setup is to crash out of a street race and then win the restart.
The trophy pops on the retry's success screen.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
steps: The event is the light formation over the Grassrivers swamp, visible only between 3 and 4 AM on clear nights.
It appears once per save; miss the window and it never shows again.
Park on the north swamp bridge, cut the engine and wait without touching the controls.
The trophy pops when the lights break formation overhead.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
steps: Ride as the passenger with a melee weapon out while the partner drives.
Swing at pedestrians on the beach strip sidewalk to bowl them over as the car passes.
Every knockdown counts while the car is moving; the trophy pops on the tenth.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
steps: Marked Bills come from robberies and heist payouts; laundering pushes them through your contacts' fronts.
Feed the marked cash to the fence contacts, since the laundromats and car washes take the biggest stacks.
Laundering takes in-game days, so sleep to cycle the fronts when they run dry.
The trophy pops when the washed total crosses $250,000.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
steps: Spread the spending across clothing, gun shops, garages, barbers and the amusement pier; every shop type must see real purchases.
Track the per-category totals on the stats page.
Blow the last stretch on supercar upgrades at the garage to cross the line.
The trophy pops when cumulative spending passes $100,000.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
steps: Eight garage properties are for sale across Leonida, marked with house icons.
Buy all eight, from the cheap storage units up to the downtown tower garage.
Sell spare cars to fund the last purchases; the trophy pops when the eighth deed clears.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
steps: The Scooter Bros app sits on the phone; open it beside any parked vehicle and hit register.
Register any ten different vehicles, since cheap traffic cars count.
The trophy pops when the tenth vehicle lands in the app.
